name: verbs_stealth_kill_scripted
about: N11's record (stories/v1/triage.md N11): the stealth kill admits a victim held by a scripted_sequence in NPC_STATE_SCRIPT. verbs_stealth_kill's staging (an idle neutral Troika human on the east pad, the player 85 cm straight behind it, crouched, a knife wielded, unseen and unheard), plus a scripted_sequence on the mark's own spot (m_fMoveTo 0, spawnflags 256 with a post-idle, no m_iszPlay) fired at 0.5 s: PossessEntity 0x101a7880 writes m_scriptState 1 and the ideal state SCRIPT, the mark's MaintainSchedule 0x102817c0 enters NPC_STATE_SCRIPT (4) and runs SCHED_TROIKA_SCRIPTED_WAIT (0xf8); the empty m_iszPlay completes at once (StartSequence 0x101a82d0 -> SequenceDone 0x101a8460) and Finish 0x101a8640's hold arm (post-idle set, spawnflag 0x100, no next cine) keeps it possessed in its post-idle, never cleaned up. +use at 2 s: PlayerUse 0x10167850 -> PlayerTryStealthKill 0x10167370 -> FindVictim 0x101be1f0; IsValidStealthKillTarget 0x102c2300 term 4 tests the state against IDLE/ALERT only when debug_allow_non_idle_auto_sk (0x10924af8) is 0, and the image's initialiser gives it '1', so the shipping arm admits any state but DEAD (7) (docs/vtmb/stealth.md:405, kernel_tunables.tsv DebugAllowNonIdleAutoSk): the query admits the mark in SCRIPT (`arena_mark admit gate=can_grapple`), and the synchronized death follows as in verbs_stealth_kill.
known_red: N11 (V7): the port's IsValidStealthKillTarget state term admits only Idle/Alert (ElysiumNpc.cpp, its comment calls the relaxed arm a developer arm); retail's shipping arm (debug_allow_non_idle_auto_sk '1') admits a victim in NPC_STATE_SCRIPT
notes: Staged red by the V3c integrator (2026-10-04, brief-C-integrator.md step 4); it turns green with V7's N11 rider. The post-idle label is sp_theatre's held-beat clip (ElysiumSequenceTests' Flags fixture); if regular_cop does not author it, StartSequence plays sequence 0, which changes the pose, not the hold. The end probe 'on_ground' is left out: red 3 (verbs_stealth_kill's) would mask N11.
